Type: lamp
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Table Lamp with a Tripod Base, 27.75"H, Black
Colors: Natural With Brushed Steel
Materials: wood
This table lamp's tripod base gives it a contemporary silhouette, but the style is softened by warm wood tones, a classic drum shade, and a fabric cord. With this combination of modern and classic influences, this lamp will blend with your existing style. 14"W x 14"D x 27.75"H Wood legs with metal lamp base and textured fabric shade Perfectly proportioned, this lamp will suit any decor. Assemble in 15 minutes or less Indoor use only
